The series is trend dominated with unstable rankings, so a robust weighted scheme may help. I will test a weighted combination using softmax_neg_error weights over the full pool.
Testing a robust median combination to counter unstable ranking and correlated errors.
Trend-dominated with unstable ranking suggests a robust trimmed mean to mitigate outliers in model errors.
Test a DBA combination on the full pool to see if an iterative refinement improves over trimmed mean in this trend‑dominated, unstable‑ranking series.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted scheme on a small, low-error subset (pool4) may capture complementary strengths while reducing noise.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a simple mean over all models may provide a robust baseline to compare against trimmed/weighted combos.
The series has high trend dominance and unstable ranking; a robust weighted combination on a more focused pool may improve robustness.
Ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a per‑horizon one‑hot weighting may capture the best model at each step while staying robust.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted scheme on a smaller stable pool may improve over trimmed mean.
ranking is unstable and models may win at different horizons; test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the full pool.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9885. Series context: trend strength 0.9836 and seasonal strength 0.466; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.161.
